title: One command on a GPU
story: You don't always need a whole interactive shell. `srun` can also run a single command on a GPU and hand the GPU straight back when it finishes. Use it to run nvidia-smi on one GPU.

lesson.title: srun with a command

parts.note: Ask Slurm for resources and run something with them.
The command to run. When it ends, so does the job, and the GPU is free again.

lesson.why: No `--pty bash` and no `exit`: the job lasts exactly as long as the command.

tasks.text: Run nvidia-smi on 1 GPU through srun

hints: Put the command after the options: `srun --gres=gpu:1 COMMAND`.
`srun --gres=gpu:1 nvidia-smi`. It shows only the one GPU you were given.
